```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{Horspool}{$T,P$}
\State \(n\gets|T|;\ m\gets|P|;\ result\gets[]\)
\If{\(m=0\)}\State\Return policy-defined result\EndIf
\If{\(m&gt;n\)}\State\Return \(result\)\EndIf
\State $shift\gets$\Call{BuildShiftTable}{$P$}$;\ s\gets0$
\While{\(s\le n-m\)}
  \State \(j\gets m-1\)
  \While{\(j\ge0\) \textbf{ and } \(P[j]=T[s+j]\)}
    \State \(j\gets j-1\)
  \EndWhile
  \If{\(j&lt;0\)}
    \State append \(s\) to \(result\)
  \EndIf
  \State \(\triangleright\) \textit{every alignment advances, match or mismatch}
  \State \(s\gets s+shift[T[s+m-1]]\)
\EndWhile
\State\Return \(result\)
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
